comparison.objective: Roll puff pastry into an even 3 mm sheet while keeping a spacer-ring rolling pin level.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual rolling, level-force coordination, repeated stroke coverage, and deformable thickness control.
comparison.success_condition: Even 3 mm sheet produced without rolling off the ends, tearing, or unsafe handling; simulator fidelity explicitly simplifies dough resistance.
comparison.reason: Deformable material shaping and bimanual rolling share neither mechanism nor outcome with damper commissioning.
